read.en: Rockwell Automation rose 3.6% on Nov 9 to $389.36, trading $383.13–394.07. It is below all its falling averages: the 5-day ($407.31), 10-day ($424.73), 30-day ($431.14), 100-day ($443.37) and 200-day ($426.93). MACD has been below its signal since Nov 5 and below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 5 ($449.34), and RSI is 36.
read.zh: 罗克韦尔自动化 11月9日上涨 3.6%，收于 $389.36，盘中区间 $383.13–394.07。股价位于所有下行均线下方：5 日（$407.31）、10 日（$424.73）、30 日（$431.14）、100 日（$443.37）和 200 日均线（$426.93）。MACD 自 11月5日起位于信号线下方且在零轴下方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月5日起看空（$449.34），RSI 为 36。

read.en: No level changed: the $375.7 Feb 17 low held, and the close stayed under the $392.54 Nov 6 high. Resistance is $392.5–396.3 (Nov 6 and Nov 9 highs, Apr 29 low), then $406.9–412.7 (Sep–Oct lows, 5-day) and $424.7–432.8 (10, 200 and 30-day). Support is $383.1 (Nov 9 low), then $375.7 and $365–370.7. A close above $396.3 would target $407–413; below $375.7, $365–371.
